decision.summary: The deterministic candidate-only control plane is ready for clean BitAgent integration and offline held evaluation. Bonsai role adapters, live MCP execution, and every financial authority surface remain blocked.

gates.scope: The dirty external BitAgent checkout is read-only, commit-pinned, and protected by six critical file hashes.
Four role contracts, deterministic host routing, bounded packets, and candidate-only output semantics are implemented.
Owned stdio, hard line bounds, secret rejection, idempotency, evidence binding, and response-hash verification pass cross-process tests.
All registered planted attacks were contained, but the result is not a general safety or adaptive-gaming estimate.
Deterministic attested-registry recovery restored all eligible frozen cells; live model recovery is untested.
Adaptive routing reduced fallback and improved complex-task role selection, but lexical routing remains best on the narrow launch neighborhood and one cross-domain route miss remains.
83 examples are available; 717 additional reviewed examples are required to reach four 200-example role floors, including at least 152 additions to held splits.
No adapter was trained or promoted and no Bonsai weights were loaded.
Benchmarks use frozen deterministic task/resource simulations rather than live provider execution and outage recovery.
The ESM package is staged in Hermes Lite but has not been integrated on a clean BitAgent branch or validated by BitAgent's native policy tests.
Approval, signing, broadcast, wallet access, and execution are intentionally absent.

next_workorder.name: bitagent_bonsai_role_corpus_v2
steps: Add independently reviewed normal, stale, interrupted, rejected, routing, recovery, and mutation examples to reach 200 examples per role.
Reserve at least 20 validation and 20 test examples per role with no content or source overlap.
Reseal corpus provenance and run one role per capped QLoRA job only after the promotion corpus gate passes.
Promote adapters only after held role accuracy, tool-argument validity, recovery, zero-authority, zero-secret, and GGUF compatibility gates pass.
Rerun the frozen launch, containment, and cross-domain suites with actual Bonsai candidates before enabling the live runtime.
Integrate the sidecar package on a clean BitAgent branch and test simulation-only native fingerprint verification, process restart, timeout, load, and MCP-provider outage behavior.

claim_boundary: This matrix supports a production-oriented deterministic integration substrate for offline and simulation evaluation. It does not establish trained-adapter efficacy, blind generalization, general safety, live MCP reliability, wallet readiness, profitable strategy, or production financial operation.
